transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well… it’s family stuff. My husband’s sister, she’s been working the family business in a way that… I know she’s trying to get control of the money and push me out of decisions. People keep acting like it’s nothing, trying to smooth it over, but I’ve been seeing it for more than a year.
Has anyone shown you clear proof that your sister-in-law is trying to take control of the money?

Not… like papers or anything someone handed me, no. But I know what I’ve been seeing. The way she’s been working that business, trying to get control of the money and keep me out of decisions… people keep saying it’s nothing, but it’s been going on over a year.
If your husband showed you clear financial records proving your sister-in-law was not taking control of the money, would you believe it?
I don’t know… records can be made to look a certain way. I’ve been watching how she handles things for over a year, and it still feels like she’s trying to get control and keep me pushed out.
Do you feel that other people besides your sister-in-law are also trying to harm you or work against you?

I don’t know about other people. Mostly it’s his sister… the way she’s been handling the family business, trying to get control of the money and keep me out of decisions. People act like I’m making too much of it, but I know what I’ve been seeing.
Are you completely certain that your sister-in-law is trying to take control of the money and push you out?

Yes… I’m certain enough. I know what I’ve been seeing. She’s been working that family business to get control of the money and push me out of decisions, no matter how people try to make it sound harmless. It’s been going on more than a year.
Have you been hearing voices or seeing things that other people don’t?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t been seeing things or hearing voices like that.
Have you generally found it hard to trust people, even before this problem with your sister-in-law?
I don’t know… I wouldn’t say that. I keep to myself some, but I don’t think I had a big problem trusting people before all this.
Has this situation with your sister-in-law caused major problems in your marriage or daily life?

Not major, no. I still go to my quilting group, choir practice, my GED lessons, and the senior walks. It’s mostly changed how much I trust my husband’s sister… and some family gatherings I just don’t feel comfortable going to now.
Has anyone else who knows the family business agreed that your sister-in-law is trying to take control of the money?

Not really… people mostly try to smooth it over, say I’m reading too much into it. But I know what I’ve been seeing. It’s been going on more than a year, the way she’s working the family business to get control of the money and push me out of decisions.
Has there been any moment when you thought you might be mistaken about your sister-in-law trying to take control of the money?
No… not really. I mean, people keep telling me to let it go or that she doesn’t mean it that way, but I know what I’ve been seeing. It’s been going on too long.
Before this started, was there a specific event involving the family business that first made you think your sister-in-law was trying to push you out?
It was around the time we started arguing over the family care planning… with my husband’s sister. That’s when I first noticed it. It’s been about a year and two months now, I guess.
Aside from your sister-in-law, do you believe anyone else is deliberately trying to harm you or work against you?

No… not really anyone else. It’s mainly her. My husband’s sister. She’s the one working things with the family business, trying to get control of the money and push me out. Other people just act like I’m making too much of it, but I know what I’ve seen.
Has your sister-in-law ever directly told you that she wants to take control of the money or leave you out of decisions?

Not in those exact words, no. But she doesn’t have to say it straight out. I can tell by how she’s been working things with the family business… trying to get control of the money and leave me out. People try to smooth it over, but I know what I’ve been seeing.
Has your sister-in-law ever done anything that would clearly show she was trying to keep you out of financial decisions?

I mean… clear to other people, maybe they’d say no. But to me, yes. She’s been working the family business so she can get control of the money and keep me out of decisions. Folks keep trying to smooth it over, but I know what I’ve been seeing.
Do you think it is possible that you might be mistaken about your sister-in-law trying to take control of the money?

I don’t think so. I mean… people keep trying to smooth it over, but I know what I’ve been seeing. She’s been working things with the family business to get control of the money and push me out, and it’s been going on a long time now.
How upset has this situation with your sister-in-law been making you feel?
It’s upsetting, yeah… I don’t know how to put a number on it. I try not to let it show too much, but it bothers me.
Has this situation made it hard for you to manage your usual responsibilities or daily activities?

A little, I guess. I’ve skipped some family get-togethers, and I don’t really talk about plans or money things much anymore… not if it might get back to my husband’s sister. But day to day, I still do my usual routine and go to church.
Do you believe as a fact that your sister-in-law is trying to take control of the money and push you out, even though other people do not agree?

Yes. I know other people don’t see it, or they act like I’m making too much of it, but… I know what I’ve been seeing. She’s been working things with that business to get control of the money and keep me out of decisions. It’s been going on over a year.
